comments.body_html:
If you are getting “instance not found” when adding the SPT folder, it may be because the "sptVersion" field in "<instance>/SPT/SPT_Data/configs/core.json" is not present. I recommend adding it like this:

{
  // ...
  "projectName": "SPT",
  "sptVersion": "4.x.y",
  "compatibleTarkovVersion": "0.aa.b.ccccc",
  // ...
}

where 4.x.y is the version of SPT you have installed in that directory. Don’t touch anything else in that file or you may brick your SPT instance.
